Counted on this phone only: numbers and times, never places or searches. Kept for 7 days.

Map stops only when zoomed in closer, and fetched only when what\'s on screen isn\'t saved yet. No stop boards in the night refresh. The offline map asks first when you\'re not on Wi-Fi. Planning, search, reminders and the rain note stay the same.
You\'re not on Wi-Fi and low-data mode is on. A map area can take tens of MB.
